resources.string: XMPP is a provider-independent instant messaging network. You can use this app with whichever XMPP server you choose.\nFor your convenience we made it easy to create an account on chatrix.one: free, private, no ads and no tracking.
Accounts on chatrix.one are created on its website.\nWith a chatrix.one account you can also talk to people on other XMPP servers by giving them your full XMPP address.
